records.name: Isparta
records.summary:
A trans visitor in Isparta is subject to the same nationwide developments as anywhere else in the country. An October 2025 leaked omnibus draft would amend the penal code to imprison acts deemed contrary to biological sex and general morality (up to three years; up to four for same-sex ceremonies), restrict gender-affirming healthcare to people 25 and over under infertility and repeated-evaluation conditions, and expose doctors to up to seven years in prison; national monitoring reports that 2025 hostility became explicit state policy — family-year directives from the head of state, a rights organisation closed, broadcast and arts-event censorship, three hate-motivated killings, 89 torture or ill-treatment violations and a 2.5-fold rise in detentions.

No statute, incident or court case specific to Isparta appears in the surviving sources for this record: the documents behind it are national-level and carry no provincial breakdown. The absence of province-specific documentation is not evidence of local tolerance — the nationwide framework and its 2025-26 escalation reach this province as any other.
